'''Croyden''' was the [[Moon/Legends|submoon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Gipper]],<ref name="TNWC">{{InsiderCite|27|The Wonder Column|The New Wonder Column}}</ref> located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> It was known to have a very inefficient postal system.<ref name="TNWC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Croyden was mentioned in "[[The Wonder Column|The New Wonder Column]]," a tongue-in-cheek column written by [[Anthony Daniels]] in [[Star Wars Insider 27|''Star Wars Insider'' 27]]. It was later canonized by inclusion in the Appendix of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.
